display.purpose: Screen and page titles only — the pamphlet's editorial serif voice.

title.purpose: Card and callout titles, chart stat values.

body.purpose: Primary reading text, rows, table labels; ~65ch column.

motion.name: pressed
motion.purpose: The pressed state of interactive elements — a dim, never a lift.

breakpoints.name: content-column
breakpoints.purpose: Max content width on desktop surfaces.

breakpoints.name: auth-column
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of profile-picker and unlock screens.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action per screen — deep green fill with white 600 text and optional leading icon.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0B5D4A; color: #fff; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; border: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Doctor Summary Callout
components.description: The Home screen's signature element — the at-a-glance health story, made to show a doctor.
components.css: .ds-summary-callout { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #0B5D4A; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-align: left; width: 100%; } .ds-summary-icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-summary-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; flex: 1; } .ds-summary-body strong { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Category and range selectors — cream pills that flip to deep green when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #F4F1E8; color: #1F2A26; border: 1px solid #D8D2C4; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip-active { background: #0B5D4A; color: #fff; border-color: #0B5D4A; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Structured at-a-glance data — label + date meta left, tabular value right, ruled rows.
components.css: .ds-table { border: 1px solid #D8D2C4; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid #D8D2C4; } .ds-value { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: Open Heart presents the user's health story the way a well-made patient education leaflet does: plain-language, reassuring, and structured so anyone — especially a clinician — grasps the whole picture at a glance. The page is paper, not glass: a warm paper-white ground with deep green ink, ruled section lines, callout boxes, and tabular numerals. It deliberately refuses the generic data-dashboard CRUD shell. The system is flat and tonal; depth comes from paper layering and hairline rules, never shadows. Calm is a feature — this is health data, treated with the seriousness and quiet care of a clinic brochure.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white ground with deep green ink — one committed accent on whole regions
Ruled section headers and hairline dividers instead of shadows
Callout boxes (green privacy, amber disclosure, red destructive)
Humanist sans body with a warm editorial serif display (Source Serif 4)
Authored SVG icons in one consistent 1.8px stroke

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on glass or gradient; every surface is a flat paper tone with a hairline rule. Separate with a cream or white sheet, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: All measurement values render in tabular numerals so columns and comparisons align.

dos: Do lead every screen with the user's story at a glance — the doctor summary is the leaflet's front page.
Do use paper tones and hairline rules for separation.
Do render every measurement in tabular numerals.
Do speak plain language — humanized metric labels, never snake_case.
Do give every full-screen route a back control and every tappable row an affordance.
Do keep the deep green for whole regions and let it be rare.
donts: Don't use glyphs or emoji as icons — authored SVG, 1.8px stroke.
Don't use shadows, gradients, glass, or bevels.
Don't place an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
Don't use a system display face as the display voice — Source Serif 4 is the display.
Don't use neutral gray for muted text — tint from the green hue (#5C6B64).
Don't stretch content full-bleed on desktop — 720px column.
Don't label AI output as anything other than informational, never diagnostic.
